 A normally routine trip was delayed for an extended period of time Friday.
 Cowboys football was on its way to El Paso for its upcoming matchup with UTEP. The team never made it off the runway due to a nationwide ground stop, which is impacting teams across the country.
 If the Cowboys do end up kicking off against the Miners, it'll be backup Landon Sims starting under center . He's starting in place of an injured Tyler Hughes.
 Cowboys basketball is looking to bounce back from loss at North Carolina with another road test Saturday. UW visits Denver at 1 p.m. Saturday .  
 Thanks for reading, and enjoy the weekend!
